question: In a certain code language, ‘NOVEL’ is written as ‘LMTCJ’ and ‘OCEAN’ is written as ‘MACYL’. How will ‘PARTY’ be written in that language?
solution:
The positional value table is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/889ff2be8a048327f450a975a401b2f4241e5f28d86896613386ad4014cb4505.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

Letters are decreased by -2 in following manner.

 
• In NOVEL → LMTCJ 

 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aae2bfd0ac57a92c9919a507b6145d035faef268ac4df6aa43472a123fd1b186.png] .​​​ 
 
 

 

 
• In OCEAN → MACYL ​

 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a12f0c0b2ccf252cd99a07b9db8042439fc7fe501d468799f1ddc4bcb41cd3f8.png] 
 
 

 

 
• Similarly, In PARTY → ​

 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ce8c9f45d27dfb5a0575067bb2d3aabb957362260b82fbca36b1fa88c67da928.png] 
 
 

We get 'NYPRW'.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
